description: Emerson’s DeltaV PipelineStudio performs steady-state and transient hydraulic analysis of gas and liquid pipeline networks. The product page describes design, planning, leak scenarios, equipment failures and surge analysis. The provider is Emerson. Coverage: The software operates on user-defined pipeline systems. Network extent, time-step selection and input-data periods depend on each implementation. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The product descriptions establish intended functions, not independently measured accuracy. Detailed licences, system requirements and prices were not verified. For simulation it supports hydraulic operations planning and emergency scenarios. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling.
